title: Elara and the Whispering Attic
logline: A curious girl discovers a magical clockwork owl and a floating key in a forgotten attic library, awakening its ancient wonders.

scenes.title: The Hidden Door
scenes.narrative_text: On a rainy afternoon, Elara explored her grandmother's quiet house. Tucked away in a shadowy corner, she found a tiny, dusty door. With a gentle push, it creaked open, revealing a narrow staircase leading up to a forgotten attic library.

scenes.title: The Silent Watcher
scenes.narrative_text: Inside the attic library, shelves overflowed with ancient, leather-bound books. Perched high on a towering stack, Elara spotted a magnificent, silent Clockwork Owl. Its brass gears were still, but its glassy eyes seemed to hold a secret, filling Elara with wonder.

scenes.title: The Whimsical Guide
scenes.narrative_text: Suddenly, a tiny, shimmering golden key appeared, floating magically before Elara! It bobbed and weaved, as if inviting her to follow. The 'Floating Key' led her deeper into the dusty aisles, past forgotten stories, towards a specific, aged book tucked away on a lower shelf.

scenes.title: The Owl's Secret
scenes.narrative_text: The floating key gently settled into a hidden slot on the Clockwork Owl. With a soft click and a whirring sound, the owl's glassy eyes lit up with a warm glow. Its brass wings slowly unfurled, revealing a secret compartment in the wall behind it!
